title: Serenity Inlet Beach | Gulf View 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Pet-friendly Inlet Beach home just 400 feet to Lupine Beach Access with private pool, Gulf views, bikes, bunk suite, and close to Camp Helen State Park.
description_expanded: Serenity Features - 400 Ft to the Lupine Beach Access - Gulf views from the 2nd and 3rd floors - 1 Min bike ride to South Walton Lakeshore Dr beach access. Beach service available at this entrance - 1 Mile from Camp Helen State Park, home to one of the largest Coastal Dune lakes in Florida. Enjoy wildlife viewing, hiking, fishing, and exploring the lake via kayak or paddleboard - Private pool with fenced-in pool deck with lounge seating (pool heating not available) - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or under, non-aggressive breeds only. Must get approval from Exclusive 30A prior to arrival and pay a non-refundable pet fee. Any unauthorized pets will result in fines and possible eviction - Access to 5 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape for your adventures - 2nd Floor Main living area with TV, two sleeper sofas and glimpses of the Gulf - 2nd Floor Renovated kitchen with stainless steel appliances - 2nd Floor furnished balcony with glimpses of the Gulf - 2nd Floor dining area with seating for 8 plus breakfast bar seating for 5 - 1st Floor Deluxe Bunk Room with living room, TV, full bath, dining table for 4 and sleeping for up to 8 - 1st Floor Laundry closet with washer and dryer - Deluxe king suite with panoramic Gulf views and a private gulf facing balcony - Open air patio with seating, propane grill, and outdoor shower - Cable and WIFI available - Driveway parking for 3 vehicles - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Welcome to your perfect beach getaway in Inlet Beach! This pet-friendly home offers the ultimate combination of comfort, convenience, and luxury just steps away from the pristine shores of the Gulf of Mexico. As you step inside, you'll immediately feel at ease in the inviting and spacious living area, where natural light floods through the windows, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The tastefully decorated interiors provide the perfect backdrop for your beach vacation. The well-equipped kitchen is a chef's dream, complete with modern appliances and ample space for preparing delicious meals. Enjoy your culinary creations at the dining table with seating for the whole family or take your meals outdoors and dine al fresco on the spacious patio overlooking the private pool. After a day of sun and sand, retreat to one of the comfortable bedrooms, where plush bedding ensures a restful night's sleep. Wake up refreshed and ready to take on another day of adventure! Outside, the fun continues with your own private pool, where you can cool off with a refreshing dip or soak up the sun on the surrounding lounge chairs. Grab one of the provided bikes and explore the area or simply relax and take in the breathtaking Gulf views from the comfort of your own backyard. With the beach just 400 feet away, you'll have endless opportunities for swimming, sunbathing, and beachcombing. And with pet-friendly accommodations, your furry friend can join in on the fun too! Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, this pet-friendly home in Inlet Beach has it all. Book your stay today and make memories that will last a lifetime! Area Construction - Our area is getting more popular each year! There is a possibility of nearby construction, community changes and projects on the roads and bridges along 30A year-round and throughout every single community. Please be aware that refunds will not be issued due to noise disturbance or unsightly views due to nearby projects. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 3rd Floor Deluxe King Suite | Gulf views with a private gulf facing balcony, TV, ensuite bath with combo shower/tub
2nd Floor Queen Guest Room 1 | TV, hallway access to shared full bath with combo shower/tub
2nd Floor Queen Guest Room 2 | TV, hallway access to shared full bath with combo shower/tub
1st Floor Bunk Area | TV, living area and dining table, sleeps up to 8 in two Twin over Double bunks and a Queen sleeper sofa, hallway access to full bath with a walk-in shower
Bonus | Two Queen Sleeper Sofas in 2nd floor living room, Sleeps up to 2 total

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
